rules.title: Dhall could not parse the selected expression.
rules.predicate: The pinned CLI immediate-dependency parser exits 1 with its Invalid input diagnostic.

rules.title: Closed expressions cannot contain imports.
rules.predicate: The pinned CLI immediate-dependency branch enumerates at least one import AST node, including missing or a fallback branch.

rules.title: The closed Dhall expression did not type-check and normalize.
rules.predicate: The pinned CLI normalize branch issues a type-check diagnostic after the import-free parse stage.

rules.title: Dhall's formatter would change the source.
rules.predicate: The native non-transitive format --check command exits 1 on the parsed and typed expression. The diagnostic identifies the corresponding check command.

rules.title: Dhall's linter would change the source.
rules.predicate: The native non-transitive lint --check command exits 1 on the parsed and typed expression. The diagnostic identifies the corresponding check command.
